headline: Seplat Discovers 19 Million Barrels of Oil in Imo State
summary: Seplat discovered 19 million barrels of oil and 157 billion cubic feet of gas in Imo State, with plans to launch a second phase of exploration next year.
why: Seplat Energy is a leading Nigerian independent oil and gas company listed on both the Nigerian Exchange and the London Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: Seplat Energy
impacts.why: Discovering new hydrocarbon reserves expands the company's asset base and long-term production potential.
